frozen_identity.question: Will Kodak Black be featured on GTA VI: The Album?
frozen_identity.rule: Must be credited on a track on the album by Rockstar official tracklist/artist announcement, or official major-platform credits if Rockstar info unavailable. Radio/game soundtrack placements do not qualify.

rockstar_official_baseline.published_content: 34 original album tracks coming Nov. 19; page labels its nine shown records as selected singles and separately covers in-game radio. It does not present a full album tracklist.

dazed_interview_reference.claim: PC Gamer attributes to Rockstar narrative SVP Ruper Humphries a comment naming Kodak Black and Sexyy Red among Miami artists that informed characters/worlds. It is a creative-inspiration statement, not an album-credit confirmation. Dazed page itself was not fetched in this 2-GET cap.

insidergaming_claim.claim: Article says 27 of 34 songs were confirmed by Rockstar; its table labels columns Music Artists / Song Name and includes Kodak Black — Skrilla. It is a secondary roundup, not a Rockstar announcement or official platform credit.
insidergaming_claim.ambiguity: The roundup discusses the album but includes older catalog tracks; its table does not establish which are original album tracks versus separately licensed in-game/radio songs. The captured Rockstar page calls the album 34 original tracks and currently presents only nine singles. No direct source for this Kodak/Skrilla album attribution was found in this pass.

findings.platform_context: Prior bounded Spotify/Apple capture (work/0340_credit_followup_1150.json) showed prerelease 34-song album metadata with incomplete/unknown artist fields; no Kodak/Bill Kapri string, not exhaustive credits.
findings.search: One targeted site:Instagram search did not produce a relevant official artist/label statement; this does not establish none exists.
findings.alias_limit: No Bill Kapri/Bill Kahan Kapri variant was found in the captured page bodies; no comprehensive alias/source search was performed.

assessment_limit: This check adds (a) an attributed creative-inspiration statement and (b) a secondary album roundup making an explicit Kodak/Skrilla claim. Neither is direct Rockstar track-credit evidence. Do not collapse title presence, radio placement, creative inspiration, or secondary reporting into qualifying album credit; equally, incomplete listings do not prove exclusion.
